```{r}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

chunk_vec <- function(x, n) {
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(list())
  split(x, ceiling(seq_along(x) / n))
}

perform_with_retry <- function(req, max_retries = 5, base_delay = 1) {
  attempt <- 1L
  repeat {
    resp <- req_perform(req)
    status <- resp_status(resp)

    # success
    if (status < 400) return(resp)

    body_txt <- resp_body_string(resp)

    # retry on transient errors
    if (status %in% c(429, 500, 502, 503, 504) && attempt < max_retries) {
      delay <- base_delay * 2^(attempt - 1L)
      message(
        "OpenAI HTTP ", status, " (attempt ", attempt, "/", max_retries,
        "). Retrying in ", delay, "s.\nBody: ", body_txt
      )
      Sys.sleep(delay)
      attempt <- attempt + 1L
    } else {
      stop(
        "OpenAI API HTTP error: ", status, " ", resp_status_desc(resp),
        "\nResponse body:\n", body_txt,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

is_surgery_focused_condition <- function(x) {
  str_detect(
    x,
    regex(
      paste(
        c(
          "surgery", "surgical", "operat(ion|ive)",
          "resection", "debulking",
          "post\\s*-?operative", "peri\\s*-?operative",
          # common named procedures
          "nephrectomy", "gastrectomy", "colectomy", "hemicolectomy",
          "lobectomy", "mastectomy", "hysterectomy", "prostatectomy",
          "arthroplasty", "bypass"
        ),
        collapse = "|"
      ),
      ignore_case = TRUE
    )
  )
}
##############################
## Unified LLM function
##############################

llm_normalize_conditions_one <- function(
  conditions,
  labels = allowed_labels,
  model = "gpt-4.1-mini",
  temperature = 0
) {
  api_key <- Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
  if (identical(api_key, "")) {
    stop("Set OPENAI_API_KEY via Sys.setenv('OPENAI_API_KEY' = \"sk-...\").", call. = FALSE)
  }

  base_url <- "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"

  conditions <- as.character(conditions %||% "")
  orig_idx   <- seq_along(conditions)

  # 1. Drop surgery-focused rows BEFORE calling the LLM
  surg_mask       <- is_surgery_focused_condition(conditions)
  conditions_keep <- conditions[!surg_mask]
  idx_keep        <- orig_idx[!surg_mask]

  if (length(conditions_keep) == 0L) {
    return(tibble(
      row = integer(0),
      input = character(0),
      Condition_clean = character(0)
    ))
  }

  # 2. System prompt – UPDATED to fix "Other neoplasms" overuse
  system_prompt <- paste0(
    "You are a strict classifier. For each clinical trial condition string, ",
    "choose EXACTLY ONE label from the ALLOWED LABELS.\n\n",

    "ALLOWED LABELS:\n- ",
    paste(labels, collapse = "\n- "),
    "\n\n",

    "OUTPUT:\n",
    "- Respond with the label text ONLY (no quotes, no extra words, no punctuation).\n\n",

    "CRITICAL RULES ABOUT 'OTHER NEOPLASMS':\n",
    "1) NEVER use 'Other neoplasms' if the string contains any of these words:\n",
    "   'cancer', 'tumor', 'tumour', 'neoplasm', 'carcinoma', 'sarcoma',\n",
    "   'lymphoma', 'leukemia', 'myeloma', 'solid tumor', 'solid tumour'.\n",
    "2) NEVER use 'Other neoplasms' if the string clearly names an organ site such as:\n",
    "   lung, bronchus, trachea, breast, colon, rectum, colorectal, gastric, stomach,\n",
    "   liver, pancreas, ovary, ovarian, cervix, cervical, uterus, uterine, endometrial,\n",
    "   prostate, kidney, renal, bladder, brain, CNS, glioblastoma, thyroid, skin,\n",
    "   nasopharynx, larynx, oral cavity, lip, gallbladder, biliary, testis, testicular, eye.\n",
    "   In these cases, choose the corresponding organ-site label.\n",
    "3) Use 'Neoplasms' (generic) when there is clear cancer/neoplasm context but no\n",
    "   specific organ site is identifiable.\n",
    "4) ONLY use 'Other neoplasms' when there is NO clear cancer/neoplasm context at all\n",
    "   and no obvious organ site or common cancer precursor.\n\n",

    "MULTI-SITE / LIST RULE:\n",
    "- If multiple organ sites are present (e.g., 'lung, breast, colorectal cancer'),\n",
    "  choose the FIRST organ site mentioned (here: lung → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer').\n\n",

    "EXAMPLES (these are VERY IMPORTANT and override your default habits):\n",
    "- 'Lung cancer' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'lung cancer' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'Lung Cancer (NSCLC)' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'Small cell lung cancer' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'Solid tumors (including but not limited to lung cancer, esophageal cancer, gastric cancer, colorectal cancer, liver cancer, pancreatic cancer, cervical cancer, and ovarian cancer).' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer' (first organ site is lung)\n",
    "- 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer;Colorectal Cancer;Breast Cancer;Ovarian Cancer;Endometrial Carcinoma;Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer' (first organ site is lung)\n",
    "- 'Cancer' → 'Neoplasms'\n",
    "- 'cancer.' → 'Neoplasms'\n",
    "- 'cancer patients' → 'Neoplasms'\n",
    "- 'Patients with cancer receiving highly or moderately emetogenic chemotherapy...' → 'Neoplasms'\n",
    "- 'Diet Habits;Cancer Prevention' → 'Neoplasms'\n",
    "- 'Prevention of lung, breast, and colorectal cancer disease in the healthy at-risk age population <br>Cancer' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer' (first organ site is lung)\n",
    "- 'Non Small Cell Lung Cancer;Cervical Cancer;Head and Neck Squamous Cell Cancer;Triple Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC);...' → 'Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer'\n",
    "- 'Mental Health Care;Mental Health;Depression Anxiety Disorder' → 'Other neoplasms'\n",
    "- 'None' → 'Other neoplasms'\n"
  )

  # 3. Loop over conditions and classify one-by-one
  out_labels <- character(length(conditions_keep))

  for (i in seq_along(conditions_keep)) {
    cond <- conditions_keep[i]

    # NA / empty → Other neoplasms
    if (is.na(cond) || nchar(trimws(cond)) == 0) {
      out_labels[i] <- "Other neoplasms"
      next
    }

    user_prompt <- paste0(
      "Condition string:\n\"",
      cond,
      "\"\n\nChoose EXACTLY ONE label from the allowed list above.\n",
      "Respond with the label text only."
    )

    body <- list(
      model = model,
      temperature = temperature,
      messages = list(
        list(role = "system", content = system_prompt),
        list(role = "user",   content = user_prompt)
      )
    )

    res <- httr::POST(
      url = base_url,
      httr::add_headers(
        Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
        `Content-Type` = "application/json"
      ),
      body = jsonlite::toJSON(body, auto_unbox = TRUE)
    )

    if (httr::status_code(res) >= 300) {
      msg <- httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      stop(
        "OpenAI API error (HTTP ", httr::status_code(res),
        ") on row ", idx_keep[i], ":\n", msg,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    txt    <- httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt, simplifyVector = FALSE)

    resp_text <- parsed$choices[[1]]$message$content %||% ""
    lab_raw   <- stringr::str_trim(resp_text)
    lab_raw   <- gsub('^"(.*)"$', "\\1", lab_raw)  # drop quotes if present

    lab <- if (lab_raw %in% labels) lab_raw else "Other neoplasms"

    out_labels[i] <- lab
    Sys.sleep(0.05)  # small pause to be nice to the API
  }

  tibble(
    row = idx_keep,
    input = conditions_keep,
    Condition_clean = out_labels
  )
}
```

```{r}
api_key <- Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
if (identical(api_key, "")) stop("OPENAI_API_KEY not set")

test_req <- request("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions") |>
  req_headers(
    Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
    `Content-Type` = "application/json"
  ) |>
  req_body_json(list(
    model = "gpt-4.1-mini",
    messages = list(
      list(role = "system", content = "You are a test."),
      list(role = "user",   content = "Say OK.")
    ),
    max_tokens = 10
  )) |>
  # IMPORTANT: don't auto-throw on 4xx/5xx so we can see the body
  req_error(is_error = function(resp) FALSE)

test_resp <- req_perform(test_req)

cat("HTTP status:", resp_status(test_resp), resp_status_desc(test_resp), "\n\n")
cat(resp_body_string(test_resp), "\n")
```
